title: asperula cynanchica subvar. rupicola
intro: Asperula cynanchica subvar. rupicola, commonly known as Rock Woodruff or Alpine Woodruff, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Asperula cynanchica subvar. rupicola include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exerting antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, iridoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
